title: Ban cap nhat v1.0.4 - Tuy chon Add Friend va nang cap on dinh
releaseNotes:
- Them tuy chon cai dat Add Friend tren giao dien: 1. Skip add friend (Mac dinh) va 2. Add friend (Bam nut Add Friends xanh)

- Nang cap on dinh va bao mat
